Best Vegetarian Food in HCMC
Jun 2024 • Solo
After a week eating out each day vegan food in plenty of restaurants in HCMC, Ngoc Tho was by far the best.
It is not just veg, but it provides a separate dedicated veg menu with an amazing variety of delicious dishes.
Best value for money no doubt.

Amazing food at this hidden gem
Aug 2019 • Couples
It would be very easy to simply walk past this fine restaurant and not notice it which would be a shame. The staff are very helpful, the menu offers so much choice and when the food arrives it is simply brilliant. From traditional Pho to barbecue 'ribs' I could not find any fault at all with the food and only wish I had space for another dish. A very unassuming restaurant that offers great food at a great price, well worth visiting and if you're overheated you can even cool down with a chilled beer!

Thank you!
May 2019 • Couples
Wow and yum. How perfect is this place!? Not only do they have a huge vegetarian menu (and cheap wine :-0) but they have an extensive non-vege menu too. This was perfect for me and my (now complaining) meat eating companion. He was getting a bit sick of going to vegetarian restaurants (bam - about time!) so this place was great for us. Even if he hadn't been there, I would have come back multiple times anyway because there were so many options. I want to come back to Saigon so I can try everything on the menu! Spring rolls weren't as good Ba Dam in Hoi An, but almost. 
Noticed a Grab driver there, so you can get delivery too.
